phase_1.fact: Frozen Reference-floor sampling admits only bottom modes 2 and 5; the first C6M attempt was rejected before surface solver execution.

diagnostic_facts: B01 R1024_T16 O0 S01 executes through approximately transaction step 260 and then fails LAREDYN0R accepted history step.
The B01 diagnostic therefore confirms a genuine failed first-attempt Reference solve after admitted hydrological response has begun.
The DYN0A strict_first_sample retry/fallback is qualified only for bottom_mode 2; mode 5 fails closed after such a first-attempt failure.
B14 R1024_T16 O0 S01 returned executable exit code 0 in diagnostic run 35531984060, showing the failure is not universal non-executability of bottom_mode 5.

Because the preregistered C6M Reference authority requires both B01 and B14 complete space-time hierarchies, B01 failure is sufficient to block C6M before numerical quality metrics can be adjudicated.

scientific_interpretation: C6M does not test Layer-ROM fidelity because no reduced candidate was executed.
The surface-driven research direction remains open; the blocker is the chosen high-resolution Reference execution route under the frozen numerical policy.
